title: Spire Inc 8-K — Entry into Material Definitive Agreement
summary: Spire Inc announced the sale of its wholly-owned subsidiary Belle Butte LLC (holding natural gas storage assets in Wyoming and Oklahoma) to Subterra Energy Holdings (affiliate of I Squared Capital) for $600 million cash plus $50 million deferred consideration payable by September 2027.
key_points: Seller: Spire Midstream LLC (wholly-owned subsidiary of Spire Inc.)
Buyer: Subterra Energy Holdings LLC (affiliate of I Squared Capital)
Purchase price: $600 million cash at closing + $50 million deferred consideration
Assets acquired: Belle Butte LLC owns Spire Storage West (Uinta County, Wyoming) and Spire Storage Salt Plains (Grant County, Oklahoma)
Transaction subject to Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust review and other regulatory approvals
Expected closing: H2 of Spire's fiscal year 2026
